rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); the Skia canvas counts the resource work it does beneath the Canvas API in process-wide relaxed atomics declared in pulp/canvas/resource_counters.hpp: every encoded-image decode site (inline bytes, cached files, static data, pattern fills, mask images) and both GPU upload paths route through skia_resource_counting.hpp, and make_paragraph counts each SkParagraph build. Counting adds one relaxed increment per decode, upload or build and changes no drawing, caching or upload behaviour; no public API is removed and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'design-import benchmark Graphite lane counts GPU uploads'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'design-import benchmark Skia lane counts per-frame resource work'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'design-import benchmark Skia lane counts scene-cache records and replays'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'design-import benchmark steady-state gate fails a planted per-frame decode'
